title: When Retain Constraints Conflict: Mitigating Forget-Retain Interference in Tabular Data
abstract: arXiv:2609.06786v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Machine unlearning aims to remove the influence of designated training data while preserving model utility, but its behavior on tabular data remains underexplored. This gap is important because tabular prediction is widely used in high-stakes domains and is increasingly adapted to language models through record serialization and schema-aware prompting. We identify a key challenge that distinguishes tabular unlearning from unlearning in free-form text or other modalities: schema-induced forget-retain overlap. In serialized tabular data, records share fixed column-name/value slots, similar attribute ranges, and common output spaces. Consequently, a forget row may have nearby retain rows that rely on the same high-signal attributes, causing retain preservation to oppose the update required for forgetting. translated_title: 当保留约束发生冲突时：缓解表格数据中的遗忘-保留干扰
translated_abstract: 机器遗忘旨在移除指定训练数据对模型的影响，同时保持模型效用，但其在表格数据上的行为仍未得到充分探索。这一空白非常重要，因为表格预测被广泛应用于高风险领域，并且正通过记录序列化和模式感知提示越来越多地适配到语言模型中。我们识别出一个区分表格数据遗忘与自由文本或其他模态遗忘的关键挑战：模式引起的遗忘-保留重叠。在序列化的表格数据中，记录共享固定的列名/值槽位、相似的属性范围和共同的输出空间。因此，一个待遗忘的行可能存在依赖于相同高信号属性的邻近保留行，导致保留维护与遗忘所需的更新相互对立。受这种失败模式的启发，我们提出了冲突感知遗忘（CAU），一种模式感知的方法，能够减少遗忘-保留之间的干扰。
tldr: 该论文揭示了表格数据遗忘中独有的“模式引起遗忘-保留重叠”难题，并提出冲突感知遗忘方法（CAU）来缓解遗忘与保留之间的相互干扰。
en_tdlr: This paper identifies schema-induced forget-retain overlap as a key challenge unique to tabular unlearning and proposes Conflict-Aware Unlearning (CAU), a schema-aware method to mitigate forget-retain interference.
